_readme: The text Sarah sees, and how many glowing things are hidden in the world.
`count` is how many there are. Change it and the world places that many —
js/world.js has anchors for up to sixteen, and the extras stack on the last
anchor, so sixteen is the sensible maximum.
What the giraffes say lives in data/npcs.json.

gate.question: PLACEHOLDER - ask her something only she would know
gate.hint: PLACEHOLDER - a gentle nudge if she gets it wrong twice

intro.title: Giraffe World
intro.body:
There are sixteen glowing things hidden out here.

The locals would rather you didn't. Follow the little light — it always knows where the next one is.

finale.title: PLACEHOLDER - what happens when she has all sixteen
finale.body: PLACEHOLDER - this shows once she's found every one. The giraffes did warn her.
